symptom: re-executing unchanged `describe java action` output deletes every parameter Description (PedApp FeedbackModule.ValidateEmail: 'Email address to validate' -> '') and Category
cause: describe prints a parameter description as a `--` comment the parser drops, and execCreateJavaAction built each parameter fresh from the statement
fix: carry Description and Category from the stored parameter of the same name on a rewrite
insight: A property describe renders only as a comment has no MDL spelling and must be carried; masked until the verb became `create or modify`
